primary_action.input: Tab to the selected 4 m radio, then ArrowRight.
primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show the path and footbridge closed and the ferry stopped.
primary_action.observed: 6 m received visible focus; all three closure statuses appeared. The shoreline expanded and the figure caption changed to 6 m.

A-1440.edge_observation: ArrowRight wrapped to 2 m. Only the path had a closure status; ferry and footbridge remained in the list without statuses.
A-1440.fact_check: The shoreline visibly advances toward the 6 m marker and agrees with the selected value and caption. Actual local water levels and closure thresholds were not independently verified.
A-1440.strength: The map-like shoreline and large editorial heading give the gauge a distinctive, cohesive identity.
A-1440.weakness: A blank status for the ferry and footbridge at 2 m is ambiguous under a heading that calls the entire list closures.
A-1440.repair: Label unaffected crossings explicitly, or show only affected crossings in the closures list.

primary_action.input: Tab to the selected 4 m radio, then ArrowRight.

A-390.weakness: The status-free rows can be mistaken for closures, and the shoreline labels are close together.
A-390.repair: Clarify unaffected crossing statuses and give the illustration labels more separation.
